items.evidence: Log shows 40 uL beads aspirated from beads_reservoir A1 into each of 96 wells, followed by 10 aspirate/dispense mix cycles, and the 5 min incubation comment precedes the magnet comment.
Comment 'Engage magnetic module; wait 5 min' recorded, then 90 uL aspirated from each well to waste A1, then two rounds of 200 uL ethanol added and 200 uL removed to waste for all 96 wells.
Comments for 5 min air dry, disengage magnet, then 50 uL water added with 10 mix cycles per well, then comment for 2 min incubation and magnet re-engage.
Log lines 6530-6911 show 45 uL aspirated from each sample_plate well and dispensed into the same-named elution_plate well.
Every move() does pick_up_tip/drop_tip per well; log shows a pick up and drop tip around each single-well supernatant, ethanol removal, elution and recovery transfer.

judge.summary: The protocol performs all steps per well with correct volumes, wells, mixes and manual-step comments. A fresh tip is used for every sample at each stage, so all rubric items pass.
